society.skycraft.say.region.sentinel: Sentinel's golden sandstone domes and cobalt-tiled arcades command the southern shore of the Iliac Bay, where Forebear fleets and royal courts meet the desert edge.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.1: The Palace of the Crown in Sentinel lifts its gilded dome high above the turquoise roofs and palm-courtyards of the harbour.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.2: Under the coloured canvas of the Bazaar of Winds, factors trade Abecean pearls, High Rock wool, and Alik'r myrrh.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.3: King Lhotun walks a tightrope between the Forebear shipping syndicates and the Crown elders of the interior.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.4: The Order of the Candle keeps perpetual watch over the royal succession from their sandstone chapterhouse.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.5: At Cybiades, Ash'abah wardens and quarantine guards watch the cursed peninsula ruins across the narrow sound.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.6: Antiphyllos presses green olive-oil in stone mills that have turned since the first Redguard kings.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.7: Myrkwasa's sea-bluff date-groves are watered by deep rock-cut cisterns that never dry in the summer heat.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.8: Abibon-Gora's pearl-divers plunge six fathoms into the southern bight with bronze weights at their belts.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.9: Vizier Samir al-Hadid signs the grain-charters that keep Sentinel's granaries full when the simoom blows.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.10: Ansei Scimitar Works tempers watered steel in oil and sesameseed until the blade shows the wave-pattern of the bay.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.11: Captain Layla Ashraf's harbour galleys patrol the approaches from Betony to Stros M'Kai.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.12: In Sentinel's House of the Seven Cisterns, brass water-clocks measure the hours by the drip of filtered rain.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.13: Zareen the Dye-Seller can tell genuine Gilane murex-purple from cheap alkanet root at a single glance.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.14: Every courtyard in the upper ward has a tiled fountain-basin and a shaded arcade to catch the sea-breeze.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.15: Pilgrims light pierced-brass lamps at the Domed Sanctuary of Tu'whacca before embarking across the bay.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.16: When the warm land-wind blows off the Alik'r at night, the whole harbour smells of dry sand and wild sage.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.17: Goldsmiths in the Sentinel suq spin gold wire fine enough to embroider a vizier's sash.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.18: The harbour chain-battery at the mole salutes royal dhows with three strokes of the bronze gong.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.19: Remember Prince A'tor's name with respect if you speak to an old soldier along the sea-wall.
society.skycraft.say.sentinel.20: Blue glazed tile, carved sandstone mashrabiya screens, and white lateen sails—that is Sentinel from the water.

society.skycraft.say.region.alikr_desert: The Alik'r Desert spans the vast sun-scoured heart of Hammerfell—an inland sea of golden dunes, qanat-fed oasis kasbahs, Crown citadels, and buried Yokudan tombs.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.1: Never cross the deep Alik'r between Kozanset and Bergama without three days' water and a guide who knows the stars.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.2: Hegathe's cliff-citadel marks the first landfall of the Ra Gada, and its Crown jurists still recite the laws in old Yoku.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.3: Skaven's seven deep cisterns and vaulted caravanserais anchor the northern caravan road toward Bangkorai.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.4: Gilane's dye-vats boil murex shells from Covetous Bay into the royal purple that graces every court in Tamriel.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.5: Totambu's twin-domed oasis preserves the oldest Crown pedigrees and lotus-gardens in the desert.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.6: At Satakalaam, the copper-miners carve their houses and ancestor-niches straight into the red serpent-canyon walls.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.7: Bergama's date-palm ring is fed by underground qanat channels dug ten fathoms beneath the shifting sand.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.8: Kairou's master weavers knot prayer-rugs and saddle-cloths dyed with madder-root, saffron, and indigo.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.9: High on the scrub-mesa of Ephesus, bronze astrolabes track the path of Tall Papa's stars across the clear desert night.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.10: Only the exiled Ash'abah dare enter a sand-sealed necropolis when the ancestor-wards fail and the Ra'Netu rise.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.11: At Morwha's Bounty, travellers wash the alkali dust from their faces under four sandstone arches shaded by fig-trees.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.12: Tavalaam's dhow-wharves load salt-blocks cut from the dry pans of the interior for the southern coast trade.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.13: When the red simoom rises on the horizon, even the proudest caravan-master shelters behind his camels and wraps his face.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.14: Water-theft at an Alik'r well is judged under the open sky and punished before the sun goes down.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.15: A desert courser from Totambu can gallop twelve leagues over hard-packed gravel on a single measure of barley and dates.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.16: In Kozanset's suq, every grain-merchant swears by Zenithar's scales while keeping a thumb near the balance-beam.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.17: Glass-winged dune beetles and sand-vipers hide under the salt-crust until the cool of twilight brings them out.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.18: Every tomb-door in the Alik'r bears the warning sigil of Tu'whacca: leave the offerings of the honoured dead untouched.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.19: Wind-catchers on the adobe roofs of Skaven funnel the evening breeze down into the cistern-rooms below.
society.skycraft.say.alikr_desert.20: The desert remembers every footprint until the evening wind wipes the slate clean.

society.skycraft.say.region.bangkorai: Bangkorai guards the great mountain defile and coastal cliffs where High Rock's green valleys give way to the arid scrub and kasbahs of Hammerfell.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.1: Hallin's Stand sits at the southern mouth of Bangkorai Pass, where the Five Companions once held the line against the goblin hordes.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.2: Lainlyn's whitewashed terraces cling to a sheer sea-inlet where corsair galleys and timber-barks ride at anchor.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.3: Mournoth's wooded basin shelters cedar groves and hunting-lodges before the land drops into the red desert.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.4: The Great Pilgrim Domes of Ayasofya draw faithful from both sides of the pass to light votive lamps under the mosaic vaults.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.5: If the Bangkorai Garrison gates close, every caravan from Evermor to Skaven has to wait in the pass.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.6: At the Five Companions Inn in Hallin's Stand, sword-initiates still recite verses from the Book of Circles.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.7: Composite horn-bows crafted in Mournoth are backed with sinew and lacquered against both rain and desert heat.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.8: Baron-House Lainlyn flies the falcon banner from its cliff-minaret and taxes every keel entering the inlet.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.9: In Ayasofya's scriptorium-hall, calligraphers gild prayer-scrolls with gold leaf beaten in Totambu.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.10: Stone-walled terraces around Mournoth transition from Breton-style oak beams to flat Redguard mud-brick roofs.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.11: Outriders from Hallin's Stand patrol the dry washes where wasteland raiders try to outflank the garrison wall.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.12: Cedar-resin and spikenard from Bangkorai's foothills supply the temple censers of half northern Hammerfell.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.13: The Crypt of the Sword-Saints beneath Hallin's Stand is swept clean every dawn by novice bladesmen.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.14: Look north from the pass crest and you see green river-mist; look south and the sky burns bronze over the scrub.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.15: Lainlyn's boom-tower can drop an iron chain across the cove mouth in less than three minutes.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.16: Caravan-drovers swap heavy High Rock wains for pack-camels at the Hallin's Stand commissary yard.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.17: Waterfalls from the Ephesus ridge vanish into dry limestone sinkholes before they ever reach the desert floor.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.18: Even the garrison guards here wear light desert mail over Breton-weave gambesons to survive the noon glare.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.19: At the Speared Lion in Mournoth, hunters trade crag-cat pelts and stories of the old goblin wars.
society.skycraft.say.bangkorai.20: Bangkorai is the hinge of the west—whoever holds the pass holds the peace between two provinces.
react.bangkorai.dragon_slayer: Hallin himself would have raised his blade to you, %1$s—slaying a dragon above Bangkorai Pass is a deed for the Book of Circles!

society.skycraft.say.region.dragontail: The Dragontail Mountains and the Brena borderlands rise in red-sandstone canyons, copper-smelting gorges, and the minaret-crowned bazaar city of Rihad.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.1: Rihad's Great Minaret of the Hour calls the watch across the Brena River toward the Colovian hills of Cyrodiil.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.2: Through the Spice Gate of Rihad pass half the overland caravans trading between Hammerfell and the Gold Coast.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.3: Pothago's red-rock gorge glows at night with the wind-draft furnaces smelting Dragontail copper and iron.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.4: Tigonus straddles a high stone arch over a canyon so deep you can hear the river roaring before you see it.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.5: Dak'fron's badlands watch-keep looks out over alkali flats where mirages shimmer like inland lakes.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.6: At the Courtyard Caravanserai in Rihad, Colovian wine-merchants and Forebear spice-factors haggle over tea and dates.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.7: Spice-Master Rasul's scales at the Rihad customs-house weigh saffron, cinnamon, and hammered brass ingots.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.8: In Pothago they worship Onsi the Boneshaver at a rock-cut forge-shrine where the anvil never cools.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.9: Tigonus goat-herders climb switchback ledges that would make a mountain eagle dizzy.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.10: Red-ochre sandstone and sun-baked mud-brick make the canyon towns blend straight into the cliff walls.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.11: Imam Tahir's water-clock in Rihad chimes every watch with bronze balls dropping into a copper basin.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.12: Outriders from Dak'fron carry two waterskins for their mounts and one for themselves when patrolling the badlands.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.13: Cordovan leather tanned in Rihad's west ward is prized for sword-scabbards from Anvil to Sentinel.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.14: Orc clans and Redguard miners in the high Dragontail gorges keep a wary truce over the richest copper seams.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.15: Lila the Guide knows every dry wadi and hidden spring between the Brena estuary and the Skaven basin.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.16: When a flash-flood roars down the Tigonus gorge after a mountain storm, the canyon rises ten feet in an hour.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.17: Garnet and malachite cut in Pothago's lapidary stalls are set into brass-hilted jambiyas.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.18: The Brena bridge-watch checks every wagon for untaxed Colovian brandy and smuggled Dwemer scrap.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.19: Scorpion-oil salves brewed in Dak'fron draw the fire out of a sting before the swelling sets in.
society.skycraft.say.dragontail.20: Stand by Rihad's sea-gate at sunset and watch the red cliffs turn the colour of glowing forge-iron.

society.skycraft.say.region.stros_mkai: Stros M'Kai rises from the turquoise Abecean Sea—an island of Dwemer brass observatories, whitewashed harbour forts, coral coves, and Restless League freebooters.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.1: Port Hunding's lighthouse citadel and Dwemer brass dome are the first landmarks every Abecean sailor sights.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.2: At the Pirate's Rest tavern, half the captains drinking cane-rum have a bounty in at least one mainland port.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.3: The Dwemer Observatory on Stros M'Kai still turns its brass planetarium gears when the steam-valves are opened.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.4: Harbourmaster Zahra keeps two ledger-books at the customs quay—one for the governor and one for how things really work.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.5: Saintsport's coral cove has careening beaches where freebooter brigantines patch their hulls between cruises.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.6: Tavorra Cove fishers dry squid and flying-fish on bamboo racks along the leeward reef.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.7: Remember Cyrus the Restless and the rising that drove Tiber Septim's admiral into the harbour!
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.8: Captain Makki at the sea-mouth fort can drop the harbour chain before a hostile frigate clears the headland.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.9: Old Salim by the observatory steps sells brass cogs and sea-charts that are accurate four times out of five.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.10: Saintsport caulkers boil pitch and coconut-fibre oakum that keeps a hull tight through warm tropical squalls.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.11: The Pillar Palace tomb cut into the island's limestone cliff holds the bones of the old sea-kings.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.12: Trade-winds blow steady across Stros M'Kai, smelling of cane-sugar, lime-blossom, and hot brass.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.13: No ship enters Port Hunding without dipping its topsail to the Pavilion of Frandar Hunding on the mole.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.14: Smugglers at Tavorra Cove can unload a lugger of unstamped silk between moonset and the morning watch.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.15: Even the tavern windows here are glazed with thick green bottle-glass and framed in ship's teak.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.16: Dive off the outer reef and you'll see sunken galley ribs crusted with brain-coral and pearl-oysters.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.17: Island smiths alloy Dwemer scrap-brass with mainland iron to forge cutlass-hilts that never rust in salt air.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.18: When the hurricane flag flies from the lighthouse gallery, every dhow and caravel warps into the inner basin.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.19: Headman Bhisha taxes the prize-courts lightly so the Restless League captains spend their gold ashore.
society.skycraft.say.stros_mkai.20: On Stros M'Kai, a fast keel and a true compass are worth more than ten titles of nobility.

society.skycraft.say.region.craglorn: Craglorn's star-carved highlands, red-crux canyons, and Nedic ruins rise between the Dragontail peaks and the Skyrim-Cyrodiil border, anchored by Elinhir, Dragonstar, and Belkarth.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.1: Elinhir's Apex Spire and tiered wind-walls crown the eastern plateau where the Mages Conclave reads the constellations.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.2: Dragonstar's Blood-Sand Arena draws gladiators and high-stakes bookmakers from Hammerfell, Skyrim, and Cyrodiil alike.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.3: East Dragonstar speaks with a Nordic burr and drinks mead; West Dragonstar prays to the Yokudan stars and drinks mint tea.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.4: Belkarth's canyon crossroads is the muster-point for every delver and Star-Gazer heading into the red badlands.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.5: At Haddock's Market, canvas awnings shelter relic-traders selling Nedic bronze and raw nirncrux ore.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.6: Smiths in Craglorn grind crimson nirncrux dust into the charcoal to give their steel an uncanny edge.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.7: Warden Kaia's guards patrol Elinhir's seven-vaulted granary tiers against highland raiders.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.8: Arena-Master Dahab and Gladiator Safiya rule the sands of Dragonstar while Bookmaker Rim takes the odds at the gate.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.9: Ancient Nedic star-observatories carved into the canyon walls predated even the Ra Gada's arrival in the highlands.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.10: Stairs-Keeper Jul in Elinhir maintains the stone switchbacks that link the lower caravanserai to the Spire.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.11: Brother Amir at the Star-Vaulted Temple of Julianos records every meteor-fall over the Craglorn plateau.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.12: When the Warrior, the Mage, and the Thief burn bright over Belkarth, the Star-Gazers double their watches.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.13: Mule-trains climbing from Belkarth to Elinhir carry water-casks up and star-metal ingots down.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.14: Rock-scorpions and scaled haj-mota lurk in the dry washes where subterranean springs feed patches of thorn-scrub.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.15: In Dragonstar's partitioned streets, the East-West Watch keeps the peace between Nord factors and Redguard grandees.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.16: Delvers at the Crossroads Tavern in Belkarth never drink to a long life—only to a rich vault and a dry fuse.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.17: The wind-walls of Elinhir are built three blocks thick to break the freezing gales sweeping off the Jerall-Druadach saddle.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.18: Lodestones and amethyst geodes split from Craglorn's cliffs fetch high prices in the Mages Guilds of the coast.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.19: A gladiator who survives ten bouts in the Dragonstar Arena wins a silver-inlaid belt and freedom of the city.
society.skycraft.say.craglorn.20: Look up from Belkarth's bridge at midnight and the constellations feel close enough to touch with a spear-tip.
react.craglorn.dragon_slayer: Under the constellations of Craglorn, felling a dragon elevates you to the company of the celestials, %1$s!

society.skycraft.react.craglorn.hold_sto: Since you quelled the celestial anomalies and canyon raiders, the highland roads between Belkarth and Elinhir stand open.

society.skycraft.say.region.hews_bane: Hew's Bane curves into the Abecean Sea—a limestone peninsula of cliff-terraced palaces at Taneth and the stilt-pier free-port of Abah's Landing.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.1: Taneth's Turquoise Palace steps down the sea-cliff in pool-garden terraces shaded by palms and blue glazed arches.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.2: Abah's Landing is built on stone piers and timber stilts over the harbour, where the Merchant Lords rule and the Thieves Guild takes its cut.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.3: The Landing Light at the harbour mouth guides merchant caravels and midnight smugglers alike through the shoals.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.4: Under the streets of Abah's Landing, flooded limestone cisterns and tide-caves form a second city for those who know the sign.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.5: At Thrall Cove, muffled oars and winch-towers haul unmarked casks into sea-caves before the Iron Wheel patrols arrive.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.6: Emir Jalil's pool-gardens in Taneth are fed by an aqueduct cut straight through the peninsula's limestone spine.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.7: Captain Hadiya on the Abah's Landing piers knows every captain's true flag, regardless of what banner flies at the masthead.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.8: Old Karim at the Net-Loft Guild can appraise a crate of smuggled Colovian silk without even prying the lid.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.9: Najwa the Gardener tends blue lotus and night-blooming jasmine on Taneth's palace terraces.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.10: The Iron Wheel mercenaries patrol Abah's Landing in disciplined pairs, yet the back-alley brokers never miss a night's trade.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.11: Down the Hundred-Stair Harbour in Taneth, porters carry spice-bales from the galley quays to the upper bazaar.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.12: No-Shira Citadel's ruined ramparts across the bay still overlook the straits where royal and syndicate warships clash.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.13: Harbour-Reeve Ben at Taneth stamps customs passes in turquoise wax for vessels bound up the Gold Coast.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.14: At the Golden Caravel Inn, merchant-syndics hire blade-escorts and privateer captains over spiced coffee.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.15: Salwa the Chart-Reader sells tide-tables of the Hew's Bane shoals that have saved twenty ships from the rocks.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.16: Whitewashed limestone, dark prismarine tile, and carved jungle-wood balconies give the peninsula ports their unmistakable silhouette.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.17: Pearl-cutters and turquoise-lapidaries in Taneth set cabochons into pierced-brassfiligree.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.18: If a coin drops through the boardwalk planks on Abah's Landing's pier market, three urchins dive for it before it hits the mud.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.19: Tava's harbour sanctuaries here hang model ships from the rafters for every crew that weathered the southern squalls.
society.skycraft.say.hews_bane.20: In Hew's Bane, every lock has two keys—one in the merchant-lord's pouch and one in the cistern below.
